product_line: Lithonia Lighting (Acuity Brands) BLT Series low-profile recessed LED troffer (2BLT4 = nominal 2x4, 2BLT2 = nominal 2x2)
license_note: Dimensional / electrical / photometric-summary FACTS only. NO Acuity .rfa, IES/photometric files, cut-sheet drawings, images or prose are stored or redistributed. Photometry is REFERENCED by manufacturer URL only. See ../LICENSE_NOTES.md.

collection_posture.summary: Acuity Brands' site terms limit use to personal / non-commercial and restrict automated collection and collateral use (docs/product/content-strategy.md rows 10 and section 5.2). We therefore did NOT fetch acuitybrands.com pages or spec sheets. Facts were read from an independent electrical-distributor listing that republishes the manufacturer's specifications (one page read directly); the Acuity spec sheet URL is recorded UNVERIFIED for a human to confirm. Photometric (IES) data is referenced by the manufacturer's own download location and is never copied into this repo.
collection_posture.method: one distributor listing read directly; manufacturer pages recorded, not fetched
